name: Guardian
source:
Our guy woke up in a dungeon without his memory. What will you have him do? Live life unknown, or go to town and find out who he is? This may sound like a role playing game, but it is a pick your choice adventure game with 90 different endings.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一座地牢里醒来，却失去了记忆。你会让他怎么做？就这样过着不知身份的生活，还是前往城镇，查明自己究竟是谁？这听起来或许像角色扮演游戏，但实际上是一款拥有90种不同结局的选择式冒险游戏。

[引自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
